scene: Close low view of an ancient Egyptian Nile floodplain after floodwater has receded: a broad smooth layer of fine dark moist sediment covers the flat low ground. A shallow residual pool glints nearby; the river and a pale dry raised bank sit quietly behind. No people, hands, baskets, tools, crops, buildings or vessels. Mud deposited naturally by water, not deliberately spread or mixed.
alt: Fine dark mud covers low ground beside a shallow pool, with a pale dry bank beyond.
